conditions: Baruuk Prime is currently vaulted: no Baruuk relic drops from missions until a future Prime Resurgence rotation.
Aya is untradeable, but it has no cap and remains after the rotation ends.
Tier-5 Deimos pays Aya at 43.48% on the final stage and 28.57% on stages 2-3; clear bonus objectives because the final stage rolls twice.
bonuses: Use the fast 'brute force' tier-5 bounty when it appears.
Cetus tier-5 is the next-best open-world choice; avoid spending Steel Essence or syndicate standing on relic packs just for Aya.

disclosures.title: the calendar is the farm
disclosures.body: Varzia changes stock every 28 days at 18:00 UTC. Check the live Prime Resurgence rotation before buying relics; while Baruuk is absent, stockpile Aya or buy the tradeable set instead.

conditions: These named relics were sold in the most recent Baruuk/Revenant rotation; confirm the current relic IDs in Varzia's shop before buying.
Prime Resurgence relics are Varzia-only. Their normal drop-table entries are replaced by Aya, so mission farming cannot produce them.
Buy any relics you may need before the rotation closes. Relics are tradeable and never expire.
bonuses: Varzia is also accessible from the Orbiter Relic Segment or the Prime Resurgence Market tab.
A friend with spare Aya can buy tradeable relics for you.

conditions: Refine Axi B9 to Radiant and run a four-player radshare: four Radiant relics have a 34.39% chance to produce at least one Rare reward.
Run Neo P8 Intact. Refining lowers its Common Systems chance from 25.33% to 16.67%.
Collect 10 Reactant before extraction. In Excavation, run one excavator at a time; in Interception, hold only two points until everyone is ready.
bonuses: Use the Vaulted Relic Community Discord or host a group by exact relic name; Recruit chat is often sparse for vaulted relics.
Choose another player's duplicate reward when it appears: you keep the item and they receive extra Void Traces.
Let enemies corrupt before killing them so the squad can get enough Reactant.

disclosures.title: one Axi relic cannot give two parts
disclosures.body: Axi B9 contains both the Blueprint and Neuroptics, but each player receives one reward per crack. Keep buying and running it until both parts are secured.

conditions: Components can build in parallel; keep a free Warframe slot for the final claim.
